video_title: Media Availability: Head Coach Brian Keefe and Kyshawn George | 10.12.26

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on the Wizards' offensive organization and passing
quotes.excerpt: we had 24 baskets, it was 20 assists. So it's the unselfishness, the ball movement
quotes.quote: We came into the game really wanting to focus on getting ourselves organized offensively. We knew they were going to pressure us. I thought we did a really good job of that in the first half. You saw the passing. We had 24 baskets, it was 20 assists. So it's the unselfishness, the ball movement, and then obviously our mentality that we wanted defensively to start the game, probably for both teams, wasn't exactly there.
quotes.social_post: Wizards head coach Brian Keefe on the team's offensive focus: We came into the game really wanting to focus on getting ourselves organized offensively. We knew they were going to pressure us.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on the Wizards' defensive intensity and physicality
quotes.excerpt: we didn't have enough physicality I thought early, but then we made the shift
quotes.quote: Both teams were scoring. Some of them they were making some contested threes, but we didn't have enough physicality I thought early, but then we made the shift. And that was when we made the run there in the third quarter. These are the learning lessons for us, you got to do it all the time. That's what's going to make you a consistent team.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe on the Wizards' defensive shift: We didn't have enough physicality early, but then we made the shift. These are the learning lessons for us, you got to do it all the time.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on Kyshawn George's offensive performance
quotes.excerpt: he's been doing that the same first two games. He did with start with his defense
quotes.quote: He played within his game and he's been doing that the same first two games. He did with start with his defense. He was wrecking havoc out there, you saw some of his rebounding. And then we were really unselfish, he got some good open threes in the corner, which is what we want him to take. But what I liked about more was his cutting game tonight, him getting easy baskets, but his defensive intensity when he came in, it changed the energy flow of the game.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe praises Kyshawn George's impact: He was wrecking havoc out there, you saw some of his rebounding. But what I liked more was his cutting game tonight and his defensive intensity.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on managing preseason lineups and growth
quotes.excerpt: we're always looking to get better as a staff first of all, but yeah, these are we treat
quotes.quote: We're always looking to get better as a staff first of all, but yeah, these are we treat these like real games. Obviously, we're trying different combinations and lineups to see what fits, but we're coaching these and preparing like these are for real games, so we always treat everything the same here.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe on preseason approach: We treat these like real games. Obviously, we're trying different combinations and lineups to see what fits, but we're coaching these and preparing like these are for real games.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on Trae Young's pass-first play style
quotes.excerpt: he came in here like that. I think this guy's led the league in assists for a few years
quotes.quote: He came in here like that. I think this guy's led the league in assists for a few years. He's got a pass-first mentality, you really see that. His ability to kick the ball ahead and then he does a great job of getting two on him and drawing crowds and he's delivering it. Obviously, they were the recipient of Trae, Bilal, it was him. Like they're putting two on the ball and he's just delivering the right pass and it's just really unselfish and that's you could see why our offense was so good is because he just made the simple play.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe on Trae Young's playmaking: He's got a pass-first mentality, you really see that. His ability to kick the ball ahead and then he does a great job of getting two on him and drawing crowds.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on Trey Johnson's potential bench role
quotes.excerpt: obviously, it gives us that, you know, that spacing for us. Like you have to guard him
quotes.quote: Obviously, it gives us that, you know, that spacing for us. Like you have to guard him. He's just a threat from anywhere on the court and you see the impact he's having defensively. He's getting better on that end. But when we get on transition, our guys know to look for him. They know where he is and you can see that the effect he has with his space, his shooting, but he's just causes gravity towards him. He's going to space, he's going to drag people with him and we got an unselfish team.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe on Trey Johnson: He's just a threat from anywhere on the court and you see the impact he's having defensively. He's just causes gravity towards him.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on DeAndre Ayton's defensive value
quotes.excerpt: DeAndre's one of the better interior defenders in our league for a long time
quotes.quote: DeAndre's one of the better interior defenders in our league for a long time. He's been doing this a long time, that was not on him for sure. That's always a team thing. We just didn't have what we would want the necessary physicality to start the game. Like I said, the growth was we made the shift in the second half, but it's never one player. That was a collective thing that we had to be better at.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe on DeAndre Ayton: DeAndre's one of the better interior defenders in our league for a long time. That was not on him for sure. That's always a team thing.

quotes.speaker: Kyshawn George
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyshawn George on his offseason physical development
quotes.excerpt: just more durability, being more confident in my body what I could do out there
quotes.quote: Just more durability, being more confident in my body what I could do out there. I think I always had the skill set, just having the strength and the athleticism to just put it on display on a nightly basis. So having that work being done over the off-season just give me more confidence to go do it in a game.
quotes.social_post: Kyshawn George on his offseason growth: Just more durability, being more confident in my body what I could do out there. I think I always had the skill set, just having the strength and the athleticism.

quotes.speaker: Kyshawn George
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyshawn George on his focus areas for preseason
quotes.excerpt: for me it's my efficiency and my turnovers. I try to make the right decision
quotes.quote: For me it's my efficiency and my turnovers. I try to make the right decision, not make the game too complicated for myself. And then limit the errors defensively, having to clean his game possible defensively. I'm going to be guarding, you know, the best players on the lineup that are other teams, so the less mistakes I make, the better it's going to be for the team.
quotes.social_post: Kyshawn George on his preseason goals: For me it's my efficiency and my turnovers. I try to make the right decision, not make the game too complicated for myself.

quotes.speaker: Kyshawn George
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyshawn George on earning a starting spot
quotes.excerpt: at the end of the day it's not about starting, it's about winning games
quotes.quote: Yeah, 100 percent. But I think at the end of the day it's not about starting, it's about winning games and I trust the staff to make the right decision to give the starting spot to whoever for us to go win the game at the end of the day.
quotes.social_post: Kyshawn George on the starting lineup: At the end of the day it's not about starting, it's about winning games and I trust the staff to make the right decision.

quotes.speaker: Kyshawn George
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyshawn George on the team's physicality and big men
quotes.excerpt: they're big bodies, they've been in the league dominating for a reason
quotes.quote: They're big bodies, they've been in the league dominating for a reason. One of the best to do it with AD and, you know, top tier with DeAndre, so just having them roaming the paint, you know, putting bodies on people when they, you know, they cut, this is screens, that type of stuff, is big for us.
quotes.social_post: Kyshawn George on the team's big men: They're big bodies, they've been in the league dominating for a reason. Having them roaming the paint is big for us.

quotes.speaker: Kyshawn George
quotes.excerpt: I seen this guy work all summer, so I'm really not surprised
quotes.quote: I seen this guy work all summer, so I'm really not surprised. Obviously, defensively he's going to do what he does, one of the best to do it. And then he knocked down his open shots, which I know he's really capable of because of the work he put in this summer, so I'm not surprised, really happy for him and I'm looking forward to see more.
quotes.social_post: Kyshawn George on Bilal Coulibaly: I seen this guy work all summer, so I'm really not surprised. Defensively he's going to do what he does, one of the best to do it.

quotes.speaker: Kyshawn George
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyshawn George on the team's high turnover rate
quotes.excerpt: I think it's building our chemistry. We can see each other like looking for specific types of connections
quotes.quote: I think it's building our chemistry. We can see each other like looking for specific types of connections, certain pass. I mean Trae Young is able to throw the ball to whoever who's open wherever on the court, so we're trying to figure out how to get ourselves open for him to deliver the ball as well. And then yeah, it's the first time we we're actually playing and compete against other team with this new lineup, this new team, doing different type of stuff, trying different type of stuff as well. But I think it's a good crash test, to say, and then we're just going to find it during the regular season.
quotes.social_post: Kyshawn George on team chemistry: We can see each other looking for specific types of connections. It's the first time we're actually playing and competing against other teams with this new lineup.

quotes.speaker: Kyshawn George
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyshawn George on his evolution as a professional player
quotes.excerpt: you have to be confident in your abilities and then let it come to you
quotes.quote: I think you have to be confident in your abilities and then let it come to you. If you put in the work, the work is always going to show and you have to play aggressive, but let the game come to you and then make the simple play every time, everything, make the game easy for yourself.
quotes.social_post: Kyshawn George on his professional evolution: You have to be confident in your abilities and then let it come to you. If you put in the work, the work is always going to show.

quotes.speaker: Kyshawn George
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyshawn George on the team's defensive identity
quotes.excerpt: it's making them take tough shots and then limiting their possessions to only one
quotes.quote: It's making them take tough shots and then limiting their possessions to only one. We're big enough to, you know, handle the glass, hold the glass, make it a one-way trip every single time and then we're big, physical enough, switchable enough to make it take a tough shot. So just making sure we lock in on that, lock in on the game plan and then we we have to be beast on the glass so that they have no second chance points. So I think if we do that, we have a very high chance to be a very good defensive team this year.
quotes.social_post: Kyshawn George on defensive identity: We're big enough to handle the glass and switchable enough to make them take a tough shot. If we do that, we have a very high chance to be a very good defensive team.

quotes.speaker: Kyshawn George
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyshawn George on adjusting to his role
quotes.excerpt: I don't see it as a difficulty, I see it as an opportunity for me
quotes.quote: I don't see it as a difficulty, I see it as an opportunity for me. I mean, if they need me on the court, I'm going to do whatever I need to do to stay on the court. And by doing that, I'm going to be able to express myself the way I express myself. That just kind of how I learned to play basketball overseas, just being able to be that young guy playing with pros, just you know, they ask me to do something, I just do it. And then you gain the trust and you're able to expand it within that role, so I just I see an opportunity rather than like a difficulty on that point.
quotes.social_post: Kyshawn George on his role: I don't see it as a difficulty, I see it as an opportunity for me. If they need me on the court, I'm going to do whatever I need to do to stay on the court.
